The atlas maps every identity to its historical entropy score, so fresh wallets carry zero weight. A vine of sybil accounts must grow real cross-chain volume to earn entropy, costing gas, bridge fees, and locked liquidity per identity. Break-even: 47 identities before injected noise dilutes farming yield below the $0.03 per-wallet overhead, making the attack net-negative.
